answer: Per-epoch weight cap on issuance is the lever: attestations are rewarded by seed weight, not by address count, so a swarm of wallets all signing the same raven earns no more than one honest identity. Splitting stake across a thousand fresh keys just divides the payout instead of multiplying it. Each sybil still needs real nectar-backed capital and a distinct creature to attest, so the attacker's marginal cost per unit of reward climbs until it clears the market price of a reward. A per-block replay nonce tied to the reference basalt further makes recycled attestations worthless.
